name: Aoki Touji
source:
A woman in an executive position of an organization called the ”Hand of Death” that’s based in Ueno.

She’s an old acquaintance of [url=/c4086]Shuugo’s[/url] from his days as a police detective, and the two of them are good friends, who let their guard down around each other.

Her physical capabilities are extraordinary, and she possesses a strength that makes her one-armed handicap trivial. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=116]MangaGamer[/url]]
